$comment: One malformed object type per file, each carrying exactly one problem, scored by `measure-comparison.mjs malformed` (docs/specs/effect-comparison.spec.md, D2). The combined case is built in memory from these files, so it cannot drift from them. Each object type's id and name are read from its file; only the field at fault is declared here, and `absent` marks a case whose problem is a missing field. scripts/tests/measure-comparison.test.mjs checks each declared field against its file.
